top_results.content:
Error Number: 10109; Error Messages: An error occurred in the communication with the light controller (CA-DC60E/DC50E/ DC30E). Please adjust the flash output duration and timing.; Cause: The next FLASH was input while the light was being emitted (Communication with the controller cannot be established while the light emission is active).; Remedy: • Set the FLASH output time to 0.1 msec (The lighting time of the light is linked with the camera shutter speed). However, the maximum lighting time is 100 msec). • Set the period from capture start to flash output closer to zero. • If the error persists even after adjusting the FLASH output time and the FLASH timing, increase the trigger interval.
Error Number: 10110; Error Messages: The light controller is one that does not support the LumiTrax function.; Cause: The light selected as the LumiTrax light is connected to a light controller other than CA-DC60E/DC50E/DC30E.; Remedy: Check that the light selected as the LumiTrax light is connected to CA-DC60E/DC50E/DC30E.
Error Number: 10111; Error Messages: The light controller is one that does not support HDR.; Cause: It was detected that the light assigned to the camera where HDR is enabled is connected to CA-DC50E/DC30E.; Remedy: Assign a light that is connected to a light controller other than the CA-DC50E/DC30E for the light to use for the HDR.
Error Number: 10112; Error Messages: The model of light controller that is set in the Light Controller Settings is not connected.; Cause: The connected light controller does not match the light controller type specified in the light controller model selection setting in [Camera Settings].; Remedy: Check the model of the connected light controller and the setting content.

Error Number: 10109; Error Messages: An error occurred in the communication with the light controller (CA-DC60E/DC50E/ DC30E). Please adjust the flash output duration and timing.; Cause: The next FLASH was input while the light was being emitted (Communication with the controller cannot be established while the light emission is active).; Remedy: • Set the FLASH output time to 0.1 msec (The lighting time of the light is linked with the camera shutter speed). However, the maximum lighting time is 100 msec). • Set the period from capture start to flash output closer to zero. • If the error persists even after adjusting the FLASH output time and the FLASH timing, increase the trigger interval.

Error Number: 10111; Error Messages: The light controller is one that does not support HDR.; Cause: It was detected that the light assigned to the camera where HDR is enabled is connected to CA-DC50E/DC30E.; Remedy: Assign a light that is connected to a light controller other than the CA-DC50E/DC30E for the light to use for the HDR.
Error Number: 10112; Error Messages: The model of light controller that is set in the Light Controller Settings is not connected.; Cause: The connected light controller does not match the light controller type specified in the light controller model selection setting in [Camera Settings].; Remedy: Check the model of the connected light controller and the setting content.

Error Number: 10101; Error Messages: Light controller is disconnected. Verify the connection and power source of light controller.; Cause: Either the illumination expansion unit specified in the camera settings has been disconnected or the power is not turned on.; Remedy: Make sure the illumination expansion unit is attached correctly. Make sure the illumination expansion unit is not damaged.
Error Number: 10102; Error Messages: The light controller has been reset because its initialization is detected.; Cause: The power to the connected illumination expansion unit has been cycled while the controller has remained on. Resulting in the resetting of the settings; Remedy: Check that the power supply to the illumination expansion unit is continuously stable. Make sure the illumination expansion unit is attached correctly.
Error Number: 10103; Error Messages: An error occurred in the internal memory of the light controller*.; Cause: An error has occurred with the EEPROM data of the illumination expansion unit and the settings have been reset.; Remedy: • If using the DC illumination mode, perform linearization again and save the settings after restoring power. • If errors continue to occur after restoring power, the illumination expansion unit may be damaged. Contact your local KEYENCE office.
Error Number: 10104; Error Messages: Failed to initialize the light controller*.; Cause: Failed to perform initialization within the illumination expansion unit after starting up.; Remedy: If errors continue to occur after restoring power, the illumination expansion unit may be damaged. Contact your local KEYENCE office.

answer.answer: The error 'An error occurred in the communication with the light controller' (Error Number 10109) is caused by the next FLASH being input while the light was being emitted, preventing communication establishment. To correct this, set the FLASH output time to 0.1 msec (maximum 100 msec), set the period from capture start to flash output closer to zero, or increase the trigger interval if the error persists. Other related communication errors (e.g., 10101, 10106) may be caused by disconnection, power loss, or unrecognized units, requiring checks on connections, power sources, and unit models.

citations.quote_span: Error Number: 10109; Error Messages: An error occurred in the communication with the light controller (CA-DC60E/DC50E/ DC30E). Please adjust the flash output duration and timing.; Cause: The next FLASH was input while the light was being emitted (Communication with the controller cannot be established while the light emission is active).; Remedy: • Set the FLASH output time to 0.1 msec (The lighting time of the light is linked with the camera shutter speed). However, the maximum lighting time is 100 msec). • Set the period from capture start to flash output closer to zero. • If the error persists even after adjusting the FLASH output time and the FLASH timing, increase the trigger interval.
